readingReview.comparison: The first reader's order matches the script exactly. Their concerns: (1) It is unclear what displays 'NOW · A-12'. In the art the label sits on the wall TV established in 03-5. Resolved. (2) Meera is a tiny, unexplained box in 04-1. She has been introduced on pages 01 to 03, and here she is background at the reception desk (as scripted), so she needs no introduction. Acceptable. (3) Ravi does not answer the nurse. His smile and nod in the art are the response, and no reply is skipped. Acceptable. (4) The link between 'RAVI · READY' and Ananya depends on the art. The art shows her holding a tablet with a notification card under the label. Resolved. (5) The tall panels have empty space. The art fills them with full figures (the vitals scene, Ananya at her desk), and the plain upper third is the intended caption area. This is acceptable pacing for the two tall beats. Nothing is unresolved.
